usedFor: TimeRex holds booked events, and Asana opens a project through “Create Project” for each “New Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event” in TimeRex, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Every booking becomes an Asana project with its own name, notes and dates, so prep work has a home.

watchOut: “Event Rescheduled” and “Event Cancelled” are separate triggers, so a project made for “New Event” stays as it was.
